documents.content: HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause.

args.reason: Order is COMPLETED, so callback should be due; need actual transport acknowledgement/failure for the bound delivery.
Callback transport is acknowledged but ACK is not completion; need receiver-side processing state to verify whether downstream processing finished.
